Lauren — thanks for the heads up and for the attachments. Procurement is OK to approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding for EmeraldTech with the following conditions:

- Threshold: invoice-only permitted up to $15,000 total for the pilot (caps monthly exposure).
- Terms: 30-day net is acceptable for pilot if Accounting completes credit & tax check.
- Evidence required before first invoice: signed SOW (received), W-9 (received), and completed vendor intake form (I attached checklist).
- Monitoring: Procurement will review spend after 30 days; this approval expires automatically at the end of the pilot unless Procurement signs off on extension.
- Accounting: invoices must reference the SOW id and be sent to accounting@redwood.com with PO field left blank and a note: "Invoice-only pilot — Procurement approval gml-20260506-lauren-emeraldtech-01"

I attached the intake checklist here. Priyom from Finance is cc'd to confirm the payment cadence and whether any additional accounting info is needed.

If EmeraldTech accepts these conditions, Lauren, please confirm and we'll mark the vendor temporary-approved.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: procurement_evidence_checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 12 KB)]
